description: 소방청_특정소방대상물소방시설정보서비스 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 소방청. 시도명, 사용승인연도 등 파라미터를 이용하여 소방청 특정소방대상물(숙박시설)의 소방시설(스프링클러) 정보를 조회할 수 있는 서비스입니다. [소방시설(스프링클러)] 건축물일련번호, 대상물명, 시도명, 시군구명, 읍면동명, 주소, 사용승인일자, 스프링클러(H)설치여부, 스프링클러(AV)설치여부, 간이스프링클... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 소방청. Its tags are 특정소방대상물, 숙박시설, 소방시설, 스프링클러, 재난안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
